title: Q-3.5  Sequence: a document request
caption: SDD v2 §3.3.5. From apps/documents/requests.py, reviews/finish_review.py, records/views.py send_documents, ADR-022 Amendments 8-9 at 2d8d4e4a (IR-1275).

steps.label: DocumentRequest (draft): only the reviewer sees it; no notice
send_drafts: open, dated now; pause the party's clock
upload each item: RecordUpload, sent_at null (held, owners only)
POST /records/<id>/documents/send/ (409 if a revision is open)
send_held_uploads: set sent_at; answer missing items; fulfil; restart the clock
after commit: one notification per party
reject: item missing again; the request reopens
